title: The Orion pirates in Star Trek: Strange New Worlds are led by a funny mom from Diary of a Wimpy Kid!
summary:
Have you ever watched Star Trek? In the newest episode of Strange New Worlds, some green-skinned space pirates called Orions take over the starship Enterprise. But here's the twist: everyone except Spock gets turned into a puppet! It's all because of a 'Level 5 Transporter Accident' — that's when the machine that beams people around goes super wrong.

The Orion captain is played by Rachael Harris. You might know her as Greg's mom from the Diary of a Wimpy Kid movies! She's also been in lots of funny shows like The Office and Modern Family. Her second-in-command is Joe Lo Truglio, who played Detective Boyle on Brooklyn Nine-Nine. Both actors are really good at comedy, which makes sense because this episode is pretty silly.

But did you know Orions have been in Star Trek since the very beginning? In the very first pilot episode from way back in 1965, Captain Pike saw a green Orion woman dancing. For a long time, Orions were shown as bad guys and pirates. But newer shows changed that. In one show, we learn that Orion women are actually the bosses! They use special chemicals called pheromones to control the men. So in this new episode, the Orion captain is a woman leading a crew of men.

Rachael Harris has actually been in Star Trek before! Way back in 1997, she played a mom on Star Trek: Voyager. Now she's back as a space pirate captain. Talk about a cool full circle! If you want to see puppets, pirates, and lots of laughs, check out Strange New Worlds on Paramount+.
why_it_matters: Old stories like Star Trek can grow and change, and seeing characters reimagined can help you think about how your own favorite series might evolve.
